description: ClickUp Personal API token (`pk_<userid>_<random>`). One token per user — workspace permissions follow the user. ClickUp also has OAuth client credentials for app integrations, which use a different credential family stored as a (client-id, client-secret) pair.

variants.description: User-scoped Personal API token. Authenticates every endpoint under api.clickup.com/api/v2 via the bare value in the `Authorization` header (no `Bearer` prefix). Inherits the user's workspace + space + folder permissions; rotating the token does NOT invalidate active sessions, only API access.
variants.format_hint: starts with `pk_`, then `<numeric user id>_<uppercase alnum>`

steps: Scroll to API Token, click Generate (or Regenerate to rotate)
Copy the value — shown in the field, no one-time-only constraint, but rotating invalidates the previous one immediately
retrieval.notes: ClickUp's API expects the token in the `Authorization` header WITHOUT a `Bearer` prefix — just the raw value. The token never expires unless you rotate it; lean on the framework's `rotate_every_days` to set a hygiene cadence.

rotation.notes: Clicking Regenerate in Settings → Apps is the rotation — there is exactly ONE Personal API token per user, so regeneration invalidates the previous value immediately with NO overlap window. Update every consumer in the same change window or they 401. This is the one provider where you cannot stage the new value ahead of cutover.

variants.description: OAuth app credential for server-to-server integrations. Pairs with a public client_id (NOT stored as a secret) to issue user-context tokens via the OAuth code flow.
variants.format_hint: opaque secret string (provider does not pin a shape)

steps: Pick the OAuth app (or Create app if none)
Copy the Client Secret — shown once at creation, regenerate to rotate
retrieval.notes: OAuth client secrets are workspace-level; team admins manage them. Do NOT use a Personal API token for production integrations — OAuth tokens carry the user's revocation surface and audit trail.

rotation.notes: Regenerating the client secret from the app's settings invalidates the old one at once. Redeploy every integration that holds the secret BEFORE you regenerate — there is no overlap. The client_id is unchanged by rotation; only the secret half of the pair turns over.
